name: google
description: Google development and Cloud operations: android-compose, chrome-web and google-developer-knowledge (live docs), plus google-cloud-mcp over Google remote MCP servers (Cloud CLI, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine, Monitoring) for hosts without a local gcloud.

interface.longDescription: Android/Kotlin/Compose, Chrome/web and Google Cloud operations. Use Google Developer Knowledge for current official docs. android-compose covers architecture, Gradle, navigation, testing, performance, security, widgets and Media3; chrome-web covers MV3, Web Store, Baseline and extension checks. google-cloud-mcp manages Cloud resources, buckets, VMs and metrics through Google remote MCP servers, without a local gcloud; each server needs its own Google OAuth connection. Personal toolkit maintained by travnie; not an official Google plugin.
defaultPrompt: Review this Compose screen for recomposition cost
Build a Chrome extension with a side panel that summarizes the page
Prepare this extension for Chrome Web Store review
